Compliance filing addressing the requirements of Conditions A, H, J and N, pursuant to the Final Decision of the Energy Facilities Siting Board issued on November 14, 2014. Please note that Exhibit 1.3 includes critical energy infrastructure information (“CEII”). This CEII is hereby provided pursuant to a Protective Order, which maintains the CEII as part of the sealed record in the proceeding and requires any recipient who has requested such information and executed a Non-Disclosure Agreement to maintain its confidentiality. See Presiding Officer Ruling (Sept. 30, 2013). NEP considers Exhibit 4, Table 1 to qualify as CEII and submits a Motion for Protective Treatment of Confidential Information and must be protected from public disclosure. NEP is providing the confidential information in an unredacted version of Exhibit 4 under seal and subject to the attached Motion. Filed by David S. Rosenzweig.
